headline: See the readings from your EARN-E P1 meter
intro: Connect an EARN-E P1 electricity meter to Home Assistant over your local network. The integration listens for meter telegrams and turns reported values into sensors for household power, energy, gas, and per-phase electrical readings.
highlights: Monitor imported and exported power, plus electricity totals for two tariffs in both directions
View voltage and current for each of the three phases, along with delivered gas when reported
Check the meter's Wi-Fi signal strength with an optional diagnostic sensor

flow.title: From meter discovery to household readings
stages: Discover a meter on the local network or enter its host
Validate the meter and identify it by serial number
Receive meter telegrams through the shared UDP listener
